{{Quote|That last hologram he triggered - the one he mocked - was Nield's father. He went into battle with Nield's three brothers. They all died. Nield was five years old.|[[Cerasi]]|<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead]]''</ref>}}
A '''battle''' took place c. [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]] involving the [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] [[Micae]] and [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Nield's oldest brother|three]] [[Nield's second-oldest brother|oldest]] [[Nield's third-oldest brother|sons]]. All four were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the battle.
